|rulings=* May only deploy on the [[Kessel]] system location.<ref name="scomp" />
* The parsec distance between the systems is checked only at the time of [[Kessel Run]]'s deployment. It is not checked again later (e.g. if a [[Death Star]] moves).
* If Light moving from [[Kessel]] to another system would complete [[Kessel Run]], but also gives Dark control of [[Kessel]] which would cancel [[Kessel Run]], resolve as competing automatic actions (the player whose turn it is chooses whether to complete or cancel).
* When the smuggler returns to the first system to make this card lost by its own game text, this [[Kessel Run]] is 'completed' (e.g. for purposes of [[Captain Lando Calrissian]], [[LE-BO2D9 (Leebo){{!}}Leebo]], etc).
